name: Optimization and Machine Learning
description: This course introduces optimization techniques and their applications in machine learning. Topics include convex analysis, gradient-based methods, constrained optimization, duality, and regularization. The course covers foundational learning theory such as bias-variance tradeoff, VC dimension, generalization bounds, and PAC learning, alongside practical methods including neural networks, deep architectures, kernel methods, and dimensionality reduction. Students gain both theoretical insights and hands-on exposure to modern machine learning models and current trends.
